requirements.text: Implement customer-specific standardization for display, error codes, labeling, LED indications, tamper events, tests, and PDI checklist.

requirements.text: Provide customer-specific technical specifications for the meter box.

requirements.quote: Standard Communication module specification – For reference.
requirements.text: Provide standard communication module specifications for reference.

requirements.quote: RF communication from Meter to DCU and DCU to HES Fiber (If available) OR Cellular.
requirements.text: Provide RF communication from meter to DCU and DCU to HES via fiber or cellular.

requirements.quote: Cellular Communication from Meter to HES.
requirements.text: Provide cellular communication from meter to HES.

requirements.quote: Suitable system is required to monitor network elements like DCUs.
requirements.text: Provide a system to monitor network elements like DCUs.

requirements.quote: Suitable Network Management System (NMS) shall be deployed to monitor the network’s status from end-to-end and the status of each and every device (RF/ GPRS signal strength, dynamic status of links with colour-codes, throughput, available bandwidth etc. in the network in real-time, and provide performance and activity statistics.
requirements.text: Deploy a network management system to monitor network status and device performance in real-time.

requirements.quote: The network management software shall be based on the latest secured version of Simple Network Management Protocol ver. 3.0 (SNMPv3).
requirements.text: Use SNMPv3 for network management software.

requirements.quote: The NMS system shall have a simple browser-based user interface to provide all the pertinent information about the system.
requirements.text: Provide a browser-based user interface for the NMS system.

requirements.text: Ensure NMS does not impact AMI application performance.
